description_en: Modifies specific attributes of an ECS instance in a scaling group by specifying parameters such as the instance ID, scaling group ID, and region ID. Currently, only the lifecycle management attribute of instances manually added to the scaling group can be modified
description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceAttribute，并指定伸缩组内实例的ID、伸缩组的ID、伸缩组所属的地域ID等参数，修改伸缩组中一台ECS实例的部分信息，目前仅支持修改手动添加到伸缩组中实例的生命周期托管属性
kebab_example: aliyun ess modify-instance-attribute --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --entrusted true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance in the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to entrust the lifecycle of an ECS instance manually added to a scaling group to the scaling group. Valid values:

true: Entrusted. The lifecycle of the instance is managed by elastic scaling, which is the same as that of instances automatically created in the scaling group. The instance is automatically released when it is removed from the scaling group, excluding instances removed by calling the DetachInstances operation.
false: Not entrusted. The instance is not released when it is removed from the scaling group.

This parameter applies only to instances manually added to a scaling group, and not to instances created within a scaling group
parameters.help_zh:
对于手动添加到伸缩组的ECS实例，是否将该实例的生命周期托管给伸缩组。取值范围：

true：托管。该实例的生命周期由弹性伸缩管理，与伸缩组自动创建的实例一致。实例被移出伸缩组时（不包括通过调用DetachInstances参数移出的实例）会自动释放。
false：不托管。该实例在被移出伸缩组时不会被释放。

该参数仅支持手动添加到伸缩组的实例，而不支持在伸缩组内创建的实例
parameters.name: entrusted

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECS instances in the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组内 ECS 实例的 ID 列表
parameters.name: instance_ids
